signIn.title: Sign in to EZCanvas
signIn.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link. No password needed.
signIn.sent: Check your email for the sign in link.
signIn.error: The link could not be sent. Check the address and try again.

onboarding.headline: Your Canvas, in your language.
onboarding.intro: EZCanvas reads your courses from Canvas, keeps every deadline in one calendar, and explains materials, homework and emails in the language you think in.
onboarding.privacy: Your Canvas data is read with your own access token and is never used to train models.

steps.connectSub: Your school's Canvas and an access token
steps.aiSub: Pick a provider or bring your own key

connect.title: Connect your Canvas account
connect.intro: EZCanvas reads your courses with a personal access token. It is stored encrypted and only ever reads; nothing is changed in Canvas.
connect.tokenHelp: In Canvas open Account, then Settings, then New Access Token. Copy the token here.

errors.missing: Enter your Canvas URL and the access token.
errors.token: Canvas did not accept that token. Check the URL and the token and try again.
